purpose: Require an explicit human decision on the exact assembled raster-derived region geometry before it may become governed document geometry for the technical scene.
proposal_inputs: R2M exact-revision consolidated raster geometry candidates
R2GI exact-revision governed human review findings
fail_closed_conditions: R2GI candidate revision differs from R2M build revision
R2M artifact hash or provenance mismatch
proposal primitive ids/endpoints/source-page coordinates differ from the exact generated proposal
missing geometry-acceptance receipt for any governed EvidenceRegion
duplicate exact-revision geometry-acceptance receipt for one EvidenceRegion
attempt to create technical identity, structural identity, canonical-write authority or engineering authority
invariants: R2GM acceptance applies only to the exact fingerprinted region geometry proposal shown to the reviewer
R2GM may create governed document geometry but never technical or structural identity
R2GM never authorizes canonical writes or engineering authority
R2GM does not infer unsupported geometry and does not repair provenance
R2C remains a separate downstream adapter even after all four regions are accepted
